name: mtp2026-app-launcher
description: MYTELEPROJECT2026 cross-device web/PWA/native application launcher and VexaAccount integration toolkit

scripts.native:sync:android: npm run native:install && npm run native:build:web && npx --prefix native cap sync android --config ../capacitor.config.ts
scripts.native:sync:ios: npm run native:install && npm run native:build:web && npx --prefix native cap sync ios --config ../capacitor.config.ts
scripts.native:open:android: npm run native:install && npx --prefix native cap open android --config ../capacitor.config.ts
scripts.native:open:ios: npm run native:install && npx --prefix native cap open ios --config ../capacitor.config.ts
scripts.native:windows:build: npm run native:build:web && cd native/windows-tauri && cargo tauri build
